route_filename_evidence.public_education_accreditation_enrollmen: Campaign202 explicitly rejects employee training, institutional accreditation, school opening and program approval as Campaign164, Campaign167 and Campaign179 human-capital, milestone or license relabeling; it separately freezes the full applicant-to-enrollment lifecycle.
route_filename_evidence.public_hazardous_material_transport_rout: Campaign179 explicitly freezes regulated route, service-area and capacity allocations; Campaign209 freezes freight booking, waybill, custody, exception, customs, return and settlement; Campaign166 freezes safety incidents and recovery. Hazard class, route, escort or clearance stage combines those terminal primitives.
route_filename_evidence.public_dam_reservoir_safety_drawdown_rec: Campaign281 already closes geological-hazard monitoring, closure and remediation against Campaign165 environmental, Campaign166 incident, Campaign178 productive-asset and Campaign200 project states. route_filename_evidence.public_protected_species_trade_quota_sei: Campaign179 freezes natural-resource tenure and production quotas, Campaign180 freezes customs detention, seizure, remediation and release, and Campaign191 freezes species-specific biological production cycles. route_filename_evidence.public_postal_universal_service_route_su: Campaign179 freezes public-service concessions, service territories, regulated routes and capacity allocations; Campaign209 freezes parcel pickup, linehaul, last-mile delivery, exception, return and settlement. route_results.reason: Formal insolvency control and court-supervised restructuring remains an economically distinct issuer state, but Campaign160 already records that no exact official identity, stable schema, issuer and subsidiary mapping, first-public clock, revision history or complete 2019-2023 denominator is locally admitted. Administrator role, plan stage, court, creditor class or discharge event cannot replace that missing base contract.

Assessment and transfer authorization are statutory operating-right grant, restriction, suspension and reinstatement states, while any breach or outage consequence is already a Campaign166 cyber or privacy incident. Jurisdiction, data category, assessment path, authorization term or remediation stage is a source, field or lifecycle variant.

Campaign202 explicitly classifies institutional accreditation, school opening and program approval as license or milestone relabeling and separately freezes application, admission and enrollment flows. Institution, program, quota type, authority or restoration stage cannot create an independent primitive.

Route permits and regulated capacity are explicit Campaign179 rights, freight execution and exceptions are Campaign209 states, and any accident, suspension or recovery is a Campaign166 incident. Dangerous-goods class, route, escort, authority or clearance stage is a combined role and cohort variant.

Monitoring and hazard classification are environmental or geological-hazard states; drawdown and closure are asset or incident restrictions; remediation, acceptance and recommissioning are project, asset and utility-restoration states. Dam class, operator, hazard grade, geography or stage cannot reopen those terminal primitives.

Harvest and trade permissions or quotas are Campaign179 natural-resource rights, detention, seizure and release are Campaign180 customs states, and the underlying species production cycle is Campaign191. Species, permit type, border, authority or lifecycle stage is a prohibited combination or cohort rescue.

Universal-service designation, territory and route authorization are explicit Campaign179 concession and allocation states, while delivery execution, exception, return and settlement are Campaign209 parcel-logistics states. Postal authority, route class, geography, standard or restoration stage is a source or field subtype.

decision.reason: Formal insolvency remains economically distinct but lacks a newly admitted complete point-in-time source contract; every other frozen route is already a regulated-right, education, freight, incident, asset, project, utility, trade or biological subtype. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign283 before formula, direction, provider, fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign284 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign283 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.

research_boundary.current_listing_snapshot_survivorship_li: The maintained universe is derived from a current listing snapshot; no historical performance was read or reported in Campaign283.
